name: Splunk Enterprise Security
summary: Splunk Enterprise Security is Splunk's SIEM for detection, investigation and response across data from many sources. Its pricing page shows only a Get a quote button for it, with no price, editions priced or free trial length.

facts.text: The product page describes managing, searching and analyzing data across every domain, cloud and device.
The page describes Detection Studio as a detection lifecycle for testing, deploying and monitoring detections. It does not use the term correlation search.
The page says Risk-Based Alerting can reduce alert volumes by up to 90%.
The page describes automatic threat enrichment and investigation guidance, and says the product integrates detection, investigation and response in one platform.
The page describes Federated Search and Federated Analytics for querying data across sources.

plans.name: Enterprise Security (Essentials and Premier)
plans.notes: Shown with a Get a quote button only. No price or trial length is listed.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists Splunk Enterprise Security with a Get a quote button and no price.
The pricing page shows a free trial link for Splunk Cloud Platform and Enterprise but states no trial length.
